placement.policy: Bunpro primary for the full type/material/descriptive-state operation. Existing N4 conditional, question-embedding and plain scope constructions in interpretations retain their existing levels.
placement.foundationReason: Small formation tasks teach the named new phrase/frame with lexical bases supplied; interpretations read supplied complete clauses. One material task chooses a component within a supplied topic/output frame, without requiring an additional unsupplied grammatical construction. Existing noun-demonstrative and action/state explanations are reused, not duplicated as new foundation gates.

coverage.formationQualification: Each small formation facet has two operation-relevant keys, not three. Kind reference contrasts presented prototypes with listener discourse; questions contrast unknown properties with clarification. Affirmative materials distinguish a single material from a coordinated phrase. Negative materials distinguish typed selection/assembly of a component topic from a complete material list versus a supplied product subject requiring only the negative predicate. Feature forms distinguish accessory state from voice/expression. These are bounded warm-up operations, not deep productive mastery; the component choice presentation does not require the same production as typing.
coverage.interpretationQualification: Each of six interpretation facets has three distinct keys: type/reference/open question, mixture/component/source direction, or voice/accessory/expression. Paired judgments share keys and related formation/interpretation tasks conservatively share operation keys even with different nouns.
coverage.scopeJustification: The 30-task bounded installment favors three independently varied inference contexts per cluster over manufacturing extra noun-swapped formation examples. The two-key formation scope is explicitly submitted for independent review, not presented as meeting a three-key target.
coverage.modeQualification: Named-frame choice recognition, typed phrase formation and supplied-text inference provide different evidence; none establishes mastery.

collocations.use: Voice characteristic, not necessarily a current utterance/song.
Worn piercing jewelry; negation does not imply absence of pierced holes or ownership.
Expression description without guaranteed inner feeling.

boundaries: The referential family in two formation drills is explicitly requested; it is not a claim that other discourse stances are always impossible.
Interpretation questions do not use a full pre-answer English translation that reveals their claims.
Both material particles and fitting ordinary polite contracted/expanded negatives remain accepted; no visibility quiz.
Feature/accessory collocations are bounded. General wearing verbs, basic demonstratives, and ordinary ている are reused background, not newly inventoried coverage.
Contrastive くは and lexical 化する remain recognition-only, outside this installment.

independentReview.scope: All 30 complete exercises, 60 literal options/rationales, initially 188 accepted completions, 262 vocabulary spans and 355 exclusions, six groups and twelve facets, changed article/source/current-count/curriculum passages.

findings.finding: Two type-reference tasks rejected fitting こういった/こうした and そういった/そうした phrases.
findings.resolution: Added all eight same-family variants with the permitted noun spellings, preserving canonical choices and explaining their type-modifier sense.

findings.finding: Two negative-material formation tasks repeated the same operation despite different component/source labels.
findings.resolution: The lid task now requires choosing its component from a complete material list and assembling its topic plus negative predicate. The separate product task still supplies the subject. Actual typed diversity replaces the old borrowed scope claim; choice/typing demands are distinguished.

findings.finding: Wrong-kind feedback could be read as calling the entire awkward completion a normal alternative question.
findings.resolution: Feedback now explains the role of どんな specifically.

independentReview.reconciliation: Original reviewer checked the exact revised snapshot and correction delta, including all 196 accepted completions. All findings resolved; no regression or consequential unresolved claim established. The bounded two-key formation scope is accepted after the genuine-operation repair, not equated with a three-key target.
independentReview.limits: Bounded independent editorial/source review, not native-speaker certification, an exhaustive audit of unchanged content, runtime testing or a learning-outcome measurement.

reviewReflection.variants: A ko/so-family instruction is broader than three named paradigms. Inspect meaningful type-modifier variants instead of treating the initial model list as the boundary.
reviewReflection.contexts: A supplied subject cannot provide a distinct formation operation merely because its interpretation involves component scope. Put the role/scope decision inside the actual response when claiming that demand.
reviewReflection.modes: A scope-assembly requirement in typing does not make a two-option polarity recognition task equivalent production evidence.
